card.title: Truth or Loyalty
card.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

mechanism: A forces a sibling to choose a promise of protection over answering the mother's direct question truthfully.
confusable: Unlike simply asking for secrecy, A explicitly makes disclosure a betrayal of the relationship.
comparison: A sibling promise collides with blame falling on a cleaner; the business scene threatens the partnership after client disclosure.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
